rule_groups.title: When things run (services, windows, claims)
rule_groups.plain: One official decision run per trading day at 10:00 ET (it must start by 10:20). A once-a-minute service tick handles approved-card fills, the 3:50 PM safety check and the AI trader; a 5-minute housekeeping job settles cash, expires cards and checks the connection.

rules.name: Daily service tick
rules.when: launchd StartInterval 60 s, RunAtLoad, plus StartCalendarInterval Mon-Fri 10:00 ET (TZ=America/New_York)

rules.name: Official claim window
rules.when: 10:00:00 <= ET time < 10:20:00 on an XNYS session
rules.condition: MarketSchedule.classify == TRADING_WINDOW (exchange_calendars XNYS); scheduled flag; no safety stop; not already claimed today (cycle_runs PRIMARY KEY day; INSERT OR IGNORE); OS flock on agent.db.cycle.lock
rules.action: exactly one atomic claim per market date; status STARTED with a cycle_id
rules.source: agents/operator.py:59-68; agents/cycle_lifecycle.py:18-20,57-91; preregistration.yaml:official_cycle (target_time_et 10:00, claim_window_end_et 10:20, one_atomic_claim_per_market_date true, manual_official_rerun_allowed false)

rules.name: One recovery attempt

rules.condition: recovery=True, remaining budget > 0, prior status FAILED/FAILED_STALLED, recovery_count < 1

rules.action: stale -> STALE_QUOTE risk block / FRESH_QUOTE_REQUIRED / NOT_ISSUED_DATA / missing mark

rules.action: any wanted instrument missing/halted/older than 60 s -> NOT_ISSUED_DATA (no trades from AI)

rules.name: Discovery bound

rules.name: Corporate-action fail-closed

rules.name: News disabled

rule_groups.title: Deterministic signal rules
rule_groups.plain: Two written rules turn daily closes into buy ideas: (1) buy the single ETF with the strongest positive 6-month momentum that is above its 200-day average; (2) a name that fell at least 3% yesterday while above its 200-day average. A third, option rule only matters when options are not paused.

rules.name: momentum_rotation_126d_trend200_top1
rules.applies_to: 17 ETFs (8 base + 9 SPDR sectors after v1.5)
rules.when: official cycle, decision date = today ET
rules.condition: >= 253 completed closes; last close > mean of last 200 closes; momentum_126d = last/close[-127] - 1 > 0; rank by -momentum_126d then symbol
rules.action: only the top 1 becomes a buy signal; strength = momentum_126d; confidence = min(0.85, 0.55 + max(0, momentum)); invalidation text 'closes at or below its 200-session average or loses positive 126-session momentum'

rules.name: mean_reversion_drop3_above_ma200
rules.applies_to: EVERY name with history (all 23 incl. ETFs, not only the 6 stocks)
rules.condition: >= 202 completed closes; last close > 200-day mean; one_day_return <= -0.03
rules.action: buy signal, strength = |drop|, confidence = min(0.80, 0.55 + |drop|); invalidation text includes 'fails to recover within 10 sessions' (not implemented as an exit)

rules.name: defined_risk_call_on_<strategy>
rules.condition: call on an underlying with a buy signal; bid>0, ask>bid; spread/mid <= 0.15; >= 1 contract buyable and available_risk_notional >= ask*100; one per underlying, lowest spread first

rules.name: Signals need a fresh quote
rules.condition: instrument must have a non-stale quote and 20-day vol

rule_groups.title: AI invocation gate and the Research / Portfolio / Critic stages (official desk)
rule_groups.plain: AI is only called when a stock signal qualifies or a held stock/option needs its daily review. ETF signals and ETF holdings never wake the AI. The AI can only pick from names a rule already flagged, at most one per lane.

rules.name: AIInvocationGate
rules.condition: invoke if any discovery row has qualified True and asset_class 'stock' (QUALIFIED_AI_ELIGIBLE_CANDIDATE), else if any holding has qualitative_review_required (HOLDING_QUALITATIVE_REVIEW_REQUIRED). Holdings rows = every held ticker in Lane A/B agent_alone+with_approvals EXCEPT ETFs when v1.5 is active

rules.name: Reserve before any call
rules.condition: BudgetAllocator.reserve per lane per stage: research $0.03, portfolio $0.05, critic $0.11
rules.action: BudgetUnavailable -> status COMPLETED with decision HOLD_OPERATIONAL, missing_evidence BUDGET_MINIMUM_NOT_AVAILABLE

rules.name: ETFs removed from AI packets
rules.condition: desk_policy_enabled
rules.action: model_candidates and ai_signals exclude ETF_UNIVERSE; Portfolio gets lane_guide

rules.name: Research stage
rules.condition: registered model (research: gpt-5.4-nano-2026-03-17, reasoning low), one turn, no tools, strict JSON schema {summary, compared_symbols, news_checked, news, missing_evidence}

rules.name: Portfolio stage
rules.condition: model gpt-5.4-mini-2026-03-17 (medium); schema Decision{picks (max 2) of {instrument, side buy|sell, thesis, good_if, invalidation, confidence 0..1}, reason}

rules.name: Critic stage (blind)
rules.condition: model gpt-5.4-2026-03-05 (medium); v1.5: packet built by code, excludes Portfolio 'reason'; schema {counterargument, rejected_instruments}
rules.action: any instrument in rejected_instruments is not issued (REJECTED)
rules.status: active (only free-text veto; the registered hard-veto/advisory categories are not enforced in code)

rules.name: AI buy needs a deterministic signal
rules.condition: side buy and instrument not in today's signal map

rules.name: One AI action per lane per run
rules.condition: second pick in the same lane, underlying not whitelisted, or critic-rejected

rules.name: Signal text overrides model text
rules.condition: deterministic signal exists
rules.action: thesis/good_if/invalidation taken from the signal; confidence = min(model, signal); horizon_days 20

rules.name: AI buy sizing
rules.condition: available = min(settled_cash, sized_notional(account_value, vol20) - existing position value); qty = available/(ask*multiplier) rounded down to 0.000001 (stocks) or 1 contract
rules.action: limit_price = ask (buy) / bid (sell); sell qty = full agent_alone holding

rules.name: No option buys within 7 days of expiry
rules.condition: expiration < today + 7 days

rules.name: Inference failure handling
rules.condition: codes COST_NO_REPRESENTED_LANE, ALLOCATION_TOKEN_COUNT_FAILED, MODEL_REQUEST_FAILED, MODEL_SCHEMA_INVALID, OUTPUT_TRUNCATED_AT_TOKEN_CAP, MODEL_RESPONSE_INCOMPLETE, INPUT_TOKEN_CAP, INPUT_TOKEN_COUNT_FAILED, INVALID_USAGE, PROVIDER_ENVELOPE_VIOLATION, RESPONSE_MODEL_MISMATCH, RESPONSE_PRICING_TIER_MISMATCH, UNEXPECTED_MODEL_TOOL
rules.action: status HOLD_OPERATIONAL with that reason; anything else INFERENCE_FAILED + accounting incident; no model fallback

rules.name: Registered dated models only
rules.condition: config research/portfolio/critic_model_name must equal preregistration assigned_models; stage 1; broker paper; daily_api_budget_usd == 0.40

rule_groups.title: ETF desk rule entry (no AI)
rule_groups.plain: If an ETF signal exists, code buys it in all three paper accounts (one waits for your YES), limited to 0.5% above the first midpoint of the run, only if spreads and volume are healthy, and only before 3:30 PM.

rules.name: Which ETF
rules.when: official cycle (both AI and no-AI paths), market open
rules.condition: ETF_UNIVERSE signals with side buy and a fresh quote; pick highest 'strength' then symbol

rules.name: AI stock pick has precedence
rules.condition: an AI Lane A result is filled or PENDING
rules.action: desk blocked AI_STOCK_SLOT_PRECEDENCE / LANE_A_SLOT_USED; max 1 desk entry per official cycle

rules.name: Only from the official window
rules.condition: evaluated_at classifies as TRADING_WINDOW (10:00-10:20 ET) and market open at now

rules.name: Entry deadline
rules.applies_to: desk entries and desk BUY cards
rules.condition: expires = min(15:30 ET, session close - 30 min)
rules.action: now >= expires -> TRIGGER_EXPIRED; card expiry = this time

rules.name: Quote checks
rules.condition: reference and current quote same ticker, not halted, age 0-60 s, 0 < bid <= ask

rules.name: Liquidity evidence
rules.condition: median 20-session dollar volume (median of close*volume of last 20 completed sessions) >= $50,000,000; spread fraction <= 0.003 using the median of 20 recorded first-of-session spreads, or (interim, until 20 sessions are recorded) the live spread

rules.name: Price and spread floor
rules.condition: midpoint >= $5 and live (ask-bid)/mid <= 0.003

rules.name: Never chase
rules.condition: limit = reference_mid * 1.005; modeled fill = ask * 1.001; fires only if mid <= limit and ask*1.001 <= limit

rules.name: Desk sizing
rules.condition: vol20 required; available = max(0, min(settled_cash, sized_notional - existing)); qty = available / limit rounded down to 0.000001; qty*ask*1.001 >= $1

rules.name: Exit plan required
rules.condition: signal has strategy, thesis, good_if, invalidation strings

rules.name: Full risk engine with reference midpoint
rules.condition: RiskEngine.evaluate with etf_entry_reference (limit distance measured from reference mid, ETF buy only)

rules.name: Arm routing
rules.condition: plan ELIGIBLE for that arm's own cash/holdings
rules.action: immediate arms fill via paper broker; with_approvals gets a 'Desk rule (no AI)' card with fill_policy fresh_quote_at_approval

rules.name: Spread recording
rules.condition: first observation per symbol per day

rule_groups.title: Risk engine (every paper fill, every arm)
rule_groups.plain: Before any simulated order, code checks size, cash, price freshness, limits, daily order count and loss/drawdown limits. Any failed check blocks the order and records why.

rules.name: Volatility-targeted size
rules.condition: sized_notional = account_value * min(0.25, 0.10 * 0.20 / realized_vol_20d); vol must be finite > 0 and <= 7 days old

rules.name: 20-day realized vol
rules.condition: last 21 completed non-interpolated closes, distinct dates; stdev of 20 log returns * sqrt(252)

rules.name: 25% position cap
rules.condition: proposed + existing value > 0.25 * account value

rules.name: Max 5 open positions
rules.condition: open_position_count >= 5

rules.name: Max 5 orders per day
rules.condition: filled orders today (ET) >= 5, unless emergency close (closing sell at >= 15% drawdown)

rules.name: No same-day round trip
rules.condition: opposite side already filled today in this ticker (unless emergency close)

rules.name: Settled cash only
rules.condition: qty*limit*multiplier > settled_cash

rules.name: Limit orders within 0.5%
rules.condition: order_type must be limit; |limit - reference|/reference <= 0.005 (reference = ask for buys, bid for sells, or desk reference midpoint)

rules.name: Agentic account only
rules.condition: proposal.account_id != configured agentic account

rules.name: Whitelisted instruments
rules.condition: ticker (or option underlying) not in instrument_whitelist

rules.name: Sell only what is held
rules.condition: sell qty > held; is_closing without holding

rules.name: No buys with unvalued positions
rules.condition: any position missing a fresh mark at last valuation

rules.name: Daily loss 3%
rules.applies_to: non-closing orders, per arm per lane
rules.condition: value - day_start_value <= -(0.03 * current account value); day_start_value = value at first valuation of the ET day

rules.name: 10% drawdown buy block
rules.condition: (peak - value)/peak >= 0.10

rules.name: 15% drawdown lock
rules.condition: drawdown >= 0.15 and manually_unlocked_after_drawdown (hard-coded False)
rules.action: DRAWDOWN_LOCK; closing sells exempt from order-count and round-trip rules

rules.name: Kill switch in context
rules.condition: safety_stopped() OR state.peak_breaker_latched OR state.global_kill_switch OR weekly loss >= 5%

rules.name: Duplicate order id
rules.condition: client_order_id already seen in this arm

rules.name: Defined-risk options only
rules.condition: options_unlocked; long_call/long_put only; multiplier 100; whole contracts; max_loss == premium for buys; not expired; same-day expiry only for closing; no naked short call
rules.status: active (buys additionally blocked by v1.6 OPTIONS_LANE_PAUSED_V16)

rules.name: Auto-approve forbidden
rules.condition: auto_approve_requested (hard-coded False)

rules.name: Instruction-like evidence
rules.condition: any proposal.evidence item contains_instructions
rules.status: inert in practice (no code path populates evidence or sets the flag)

rule_groups.title: Approval cards (with_approvals arm)
rule_groups.plain: The 'with approvals' account only trades when you answer YES on a card. AI stock cards are priced at the moment the card was issued; desk ETF cards wait for a fresh price after your YES.

rules.name: AI card issued only after agent_alone fills
rules.condition: agent_alone _execute status == filled
rules.action: PENDING card (body <= 150 words) expiring at session close (live) or +30 min (non-live); notification enqueued

rules.name: AI card YES fills at issue-time quote
rules.condition: now < expires
rules.action: _execute on with_approvals with the stored issue-time quote at time=issued (labelled proposal_time_counterfactual); NO/expired -> skipped fill record

rules.name: Desk card YES waits for a fresh quote
rules.when: YES -> APPROVED_AWAITING_FILL; fills attempted on even minutes while market open
rules.condition: now < card expiry (entry deadline); quote fresh (<= 60 s) and not halted; ask*1.001 <= card limit; risk engine passes with reference midpoint
rules.action: fill -> status YES; risk block -> APPROVED_RISK_BLOCKED; past expiry -> APPROVED_NOT_FILLED; otherwise WAITING (NO_FRESH_QUOTE/ABOVE_LIMIT)

rules.name: SELL cards from rule exits
rules.applies_to: with_approvals ETF exit, stock backstop, 15:50 protective
rules.condition: backstop and protective skip if any PENDING sell card for the same ticker exists; ETF exit skips only if the same proposal id exists
rules.action: PENDING SELL card expiring at session close; YES fills at the card's issue-time quote; NO keeps the position

rules.name: Expiry
rules.condition: now >= expires
rules.action: EXPIRED (no carry to next day; approval after expiry rejected)

rule_groups.title: Selling rules (registered exits)
rule_groups.plain: ETFs are sold when they close at/below their 200-day average or 6-month momentum turns non-positive. AI-bought stocks are reviewed by the AI daily, with a code backstop at the 200-day average or after 20 sessions. At 3:50 PM a safety check sells anything 8% under cost or trading under its 200-day average.

rules.name: v1.5.1 ETF exit
rules.applies_to: Lane A ETF positions in agent_alone, with_approvals, deterministic_no_ai
rules.when: 10:00 official cycle, after entries, market open
rules.condition: from today's completed-session features: above_ma200 is False (close <= 200-session mean) OR momentum_126d <= 0
rules.action: full position: agent_alone and deterministic_no_ai sell at fresh bid (<=60 s); with_approvals SELL card; missing features -> HOLD EXIT_EVIDENCE_MISSING; stale quote -> EXIT_BLOCKED FRESH_QUOTE_REQUIRED
rules.why: operator intent: 'agents should sell when conditions are right' (preregistration-amendment-v1.5.1.yaml:operator_signature.intent_source)

rules.name: v1.5.2 stock backstop
rules.applies_to: Lane A positions with asset_class 'stock', all three arms
rules.when: 10:00 cycle, after AI stages and after ETF exits
rules.condition: above_ma200 is False OR >= 20 session-close dates after the ET date of the last buy fill
rules.action: agent_alone/deterministic_no_ai sell full position at fresh bid; with_approvals SELL card unless a sell card for the ticker is PENDING

rules.name: v1.6 protective exit
rules.applies_to: Lane A ETF and stock positions, all three arms
rules.when: once per session, 15:50 <= ET < 15:58 (early close: close-10 min <= t < close-2 min), inside the daily service tick
rules.condition: fresh bid (<=60 s): (1) bid <= average_cost * (1 - 0.08) -> PROTECTIVE_STOP_BELOW_AVERAGE_COST; else (2) bid <= mean of last 200 completed closes -> LIVE_PRICE_AT_OR_BELOW_200_DAY_AVERAGE; else (3) ETF only: bid/close_126_sessions_ago - 1 <= 0 -> LIVE_MOMENTUM_126D_NOT_POSITIVE
rules.action: immediate arms sell full quantity at bid; with_approvals SELL card expiring at close (skipped if a sell card is pending); every check recorded; missing quote -> HOLD FRESH_QUOTE_REQUIRED; history error -> HOLD HISTORY_UNAVAILABLE; failed attempt releases the claim and retries next tick inside the window
rules.why: review found exits waited for the next 10:00 run (preregistration-amendment-v1.6.0.yaml:rationale)

rules.name: AI daily review of held stocks/options
rules.applies_to: Lane A stocks, Lane B options (not ETFs under v1.5)
rules.condition: holding exists -> AI gate opens
rules.action: Portfolio may issue a sell pick (full agent_alone quantity at bid)

rules.name: Option expiry settlement
rules.condition: expiry < today and the underlying's close for the expiry date exists
rules.action: cash-settle intrinsic value (call max(0, S-K), put max(0, K-S)) x qty x 100; cash settled T+1 after expiry; missing close -> position frozen unvalued

rules.name: No resting stop orders
rules.action: exits only at the 10:00 run and the 15:50 check (paper); no broker orders exist

rules.name: Registered baseline exit (v1.4.2)
rules.condition: earliest of registered invalidation or close of 20th session after entry
rules.status: registered; for deterministic_no_ai ETFs the v1.5.1 exit is what runs (no 20-session time stop for ETFs in code)

rule_groups.title: Paper ledger, valuation and settlement
rule_groups.plain: Every paper account keeps settled and unsettled cash. Sale money becomes spendable the next business day. Positions are valued at the bid.

rules.name: Paper accounts
rules.applies_to: Lane A and B x agent_alone, with_approvals, deterministic_no_ai
rules.action: state: settled_cash, unsettled_cash, positions, fills, seen ids, peak, start, weekly_start_value, peak_breaker_latched, global_kill_switch, marks

rules.name: v1.6 Lane A rebase to $25,000
rules.when: once, at the first official v1.6 live_readonly cycle with desk policy enabled
rules.condition: no capital_rebases row for 1.6.0
rules.action: archive build-phase state, reset each arm to fresh_state(25000) (peak/start/weekly = 25000, latches False), expire pending Lane A cards, record capital_rebase

rules.name: Mark-to-bid
rules.when: each official cycle (once in the no-AI path; before and after decisions in the AI path); not at 15:50
rules.condition: fresh quote <= 60 s
rules.action: mark = bid; missing marks -> value None (and buys blocked); peak updated; drawdown >= 10% sets peak_breaker_latched; >= 15% sets global_kill_switch

rules.name: T+1 settlement
rules.condition: settlement due date <= today ET; due = next weekday that is not a regular NYSE holiday
rules.action: move amount from unsettled to settled

rules.name: Fractional shares
rules.action: quantity to 6 decimals, minimum $1 notional (desk); options whole contracts

rule_groups.title: Safety stops, tripwire and connection
rule_groups.plain: Any unexpected change in the real Robinhood Agentic account, a refused read or an unexpected capability stops all paper trading until the operator reviews it. The operator can also pause from the dashboard.

rules.name: STOP_TRADING pause
rules.condition: file STOP_TRADING beside agent.db (or symlink)
rules.action: safety_stopped() True: no claim, no cycle ownership, no inference, no protective check, risk KILL_SWITCH for buys; resume refused while an incident is unresolved

rules.name: INCIDENT_STOP latch
rules.condition: unexpected capability, tripwire violation, snapshot/order-history incomplete, etc.

Official cycle: v1.6 rebase (first run only) -> read-only collection with tripwire -> snapshot -> option expiry settlement -> signals -> AI gate -> [no-AI path: valuation, spread record, ETF desk entry, ETF exit, stock backstop] or [AI path: budget reservation, Research, Portfolio, Critic, final refresh, valuation, AI issue, spread record, desk entry, exits, valuation, VTI benchmark] -> capsule -> terminal record.
Approved desk ETF cards (APPROVED_AWAITING_FILL) try to fill at a fresh quote within the limit; on odd minutes/closed market, cards past their window are closed APPROVED_NOT_FILLED.
Operator answers PENDING cards on the Approvals page (AI cards and sell cards expire at session close; desk BUY cards at the entry deadline).

Claim window closes. If no run was recorded, maintenance raises MISSED_WINDOW (priority 1). A STARTED claim older than 30 min becomes FAILED_STALLED. (Registered single recovery attempt is not wired.)

AI trader morning run (only if trader.db exists, today's official cycle_runs status == COMPLETED, < 3 attempts today, not retired): settle T+1, code exits (PAPER), management cards, Scout -> PM -> code checks -> Critic -> fills (PAPER) or WATCH_APPROVED (WATCH_ONLY). Book B approved cards fill at a fresh quote if ask*1.001 <= A's fill mark * 1.005 and before 15:30.
Entry deadline: last ETF desk entry/fill (min(15:30, close-30 min)); desk BUY cards expire; AI trader entries stop and its book-B cards expire.
v1.6 protective exit check, once per session (early close: close-10 min to close-2 min). AI trader protective check in the same window (PAPER mode only).
Close. PENDING AI cards and SELL cards expire (session_close); maintenance marks them EXPIRED within ~5 min.
Nightly S&P 500 shadow screen (read-only, own store, never trades).
Maintenance: reconcile, expire, settle, weekly report, notifications, authorization check.

known_issues.issue: Robinhood daily bars have begins_at 00:00Z, so converting to ET labels each session one calendar day early. Documented as 'decisions unaffected' (the 10:00 run uses the prior session's close) but date-keyed lookups are off by one: option expiry-close settlement (session_closes[expiry]) and the v1.5.2 20-session backstop count (closes dated after the entry day). The same parse is used in research/history_backfill.py, so research backtest bar dates are also labelled a day early. Fix planned 'in data parsing before options resume'. Not independently verified whether today's partial bar can ever be labelled 'yesterday' and slip through the < today filter.

peak_breaker_latched is set at a 10% drawdown and nothing clears it (per arm, per lane); the 15% global_kill_switch flag likewise. Registered re-arm via documented operator review is not wired (risk/breakers.py BreakerState has a rearm path but is unused). In the backtest the latch froze buying from July 2010. Draft v1.6.1 (unsigned) proposes a reset.

The VTI benchmark row is appended to daily_values only at the end of the AI path (after line 811). The no-AI path (most days) returns at line 686 without writing it. eval/promotion_stats.py pairs arm values with VTI by day, so comparable sessions accrue only on AI-invoked days, and the weekly report's VTI line is similarly starved.

Registered approval-time buy fill = fresh_ask x (1 + 0.001) and the guide says 'modeled fill = ask x 1.001', but PaperBroker records buy fills at the plain ask. The 0.1% is used only for trigger/limit checks, so official paper results omit the registered slippage cost (the AI trader does apply it).
Lane B new buys are paused by v1.6; even before the pause, Lane B was structurally idle because one contract usually costs more than the $500 lane (option screen 878 seen -> 0 passed on 2026-09-30).
With-approvals AI stock cards (and rule SELL cards) fill at the issue-time quote, not the price when the operator approves.

An AI card for with_approvals is issued only if agent_alone filled first, and AI sell quantity is read from agent_alone's holdings. If the two arms diverge (e.g. operator said NO earlier, or agent_alone was risk-blocked), with_approvals cannot receive the same AI decision.

mean_reversion_drop3_above_ma200 is evaluated on every name, including ETFs (UI labels it 'Mean reversion (all names)'), while the guide calls it a stock-only 'Stock dip' rule. The desk picks the top ETF signal by 'strength', mixing units (momentum_126d vs one-day drop magnitude). An ETF bought on a dip is then governed by the momentum rule's exit (MA200/momentum), and the dip rule's own 'fails to recover within 10 sessions' invalidation is not implemented.

v1.5 forbids AI voting on ETFs, but enforcement is packet-level only: model_candidates and ai_signals drop ETFs, yet eligible_instruments (sent to Portfolio and Critic) still includes ETF signals and held ETFs, and apply_decision has no ETF exclusion. A Portfolio pick of a signalled ETF (buy) or a held ETF (sell) would be executed.

Large parts of v1.4.2 are not in runtime code: evidence quality score, net-edge gates and probability shrinkage, Brier calibration, AI stop rule, shadow Kelly, seeded_random / exposure_matched_vti / lane_b_delta arms, selection-reference shadow ledger and VOID_DATA paging, research blinding and concordance scoring, Critic hard-veto/advisory categories, combined-portfolio breakers.
The registered single recovery attempt exists in CycleLifecycle.acquire(recovery=True) but nothing calls it; a failed 10:00 run is not retried that day (the operator only gets a page).

Breakers are per arm per lane only (no combined-portfolio scope). Daily reference = value at the day's first valuation (10:00 marks, not literally the prior close); weekly reference = value at the first valuation of the ISO week. Valuations happen only in the 10:00 run, not at 15:50.

'Closing sells are always allowed' holds only inside the risk engine. While STOP_TRADING/INCIDENT_STOP is present there is no claim, protective ownership fails and the AI trader hook skips, so no exits run at all during a pause.

The real-account tripwire runs only in the 10:00 collection (LiveReader.collect). Protective checks, approval-fill ticks, the AI trader and the nightly screen use gateway.call directly after preflight (the $1,200 bounded-cash preflight still runs), so intraday account changes are detected only the next morning.

The desk planner requires the evaluation time to be inside 10:00-10:20 (TRADING_WINDOW). On the AI path, evaluation happens after the AI stages; if they run past 10:20 the desk entry is blocked OUTSIDE_OFFICIAL_SESSION.

The interim spread rule registered as max(live spread at reference, live spread at fill) is implemented as liquidity_spread(recorded, quote, quote) at issue; the approval-time fill does not re-check spread.

promotion_stats uses a circular fixed-length (21) block bootstrap with seed 11, not a stationary (random-length) bootstrap as worded in v1.6. 'Filled decisions' counts every filled fill (buys, rule exits, protective sells). Arm values are 10:00 bid marks while VTI is the prior session's close keyed to the run day (timing offset).

The guide/walkthrough and the repo config/settings.yaml name 'gpt-5.6-luna' (Research) and 'gpt-5.6-terra' (Portfolio, Critic), but the official scheduled path refuses any config whose model names differ from the registered dated IDs (gpt-5.4-nano-2026-03-17 / gpt-5.4-mini-2026-03-17 / gpt-5.4-2026-03-05).
